d: Al Jomaih Energy & Water (AEW) headquartered in Saudi Arabia, is a fast-growing investor, lead develper, and operator of utility and infrastructure projects in various geographical markets such as KSA, GCC, Asia & North Africa, with investments in 6 GW of Conventional and Solar power plants, and around 700,000 m3/day of water.

AEW was established in 2007, as a subsidiary of Al Jomaih Holding Company, a leading Saudi conglomerate with a legacy spanning over 80 years, focused on enabling sustainable, social, and economic progress in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and beyond.

At AEW, our mission is to tackle new technologies, solve complex problems, and leverage our expertise to unlock opportunities in the Power, Renewables & Water Sectors, while driving impact for our stakeholders across the value chain.

This role serves as the central governance and document control function for the Company’s multi-jurisdictional project portfolio. The position is responsible for ensuring that all subsidiaries of the Company operate in compliance with Shareholders Agreements, corporate governance and local statutory requirements, while overseeing the implementation and management of document lifecycle and records management systems across the organization.
q: 8+ years’ experience, including 4+ years in executive management.
Bilingual in Arabic and English (written and spoken).
Knowledge of JV governance, consortium & shareholders agreements.
Familiar with KSA corporate and regulatory requirements.
Experience with corporate/legal documentation and Document Management Systems.
The role requires strict confidentiality and professional handling of sensitive legal, corporate, and commercial information at all times.
r: Coordinate and manage Board and Shareholders meetings, including scheduling, logistics and communication.
Prepare and circulate meeting agendas, board packs and supporting materials within required timelines.
Draft and issue meeting notices, written resolutions, proxy forms and minutes.
Monitor implementation of Board resolutions and track action items to ensure timely completion.
Provide governance support to Company-nominated directors on subsidiaries, including onboarding and orientation of new Board members.
Brief directors on upcoming agenda items and support them in fulfilling fiduciary duties, including proper documentation of dissent/consent in minutes.
Develop and coordinate governance training programmes and materials to strengthen Board effectiveness.
Serve as the governance focal point and corporate secretarial support for Company-led subsidiaries.
Ensure compliance with Shareholders Agreements, constitutional documents, quorum requirements, governance protocols and applicable legal and regulatory obligations.
Maintain accurate corporate records and ensure timely filing of statutory approvals, resolutions and governance documentation.
Maintain and update statutory registers, minutes, resolutions, and corporate records in compliance with legal and company requirements.
Establish and manage a structured filing, archiving, and electronic document management system for corporate and project documentation.
Oversee the full document lifecycle, including drafting, version control, execution, storage, retrieval and disposal in line with retention policies.
Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, accuracy and appropriate access controls across all record systems.
Coordinate notarization, legalization and execution of corporate documents.

d: Jumeirah Group, a member of Dubai Holding, has been making a distinguished impact on the global hospitality market for more than two decades with its Stay Different™ brand promise.

Its award-winning destinations, such as the iconic Burj Al Arab Jumeirah, position service beyond expectations, elevated dining destinations and surprising architecture and design at the heart of every guest experience.
Today, Jumeirah operates a world-class portfolio of 23 properties across the Middle East, Europe and Asia and employs over 8,000 colleagues, representing over 106 nationalities.

As Jumeirah continues to expand its global portfolio and scales up its operations to the next level of growth, it remains fully committed to developing and empowering our colleagues to excel in world class environments.
Jumeirah is committed to embedding equality, diversity, and inclusion in all its practices, embracing a culture that celebrates diversity.

Jumeirah Gulf of Bahrain is an idyllic getaway situated majestically on the shores of the Gulf and takes its architectural inspiration from the gentle movements of the sea. The resort’s cluster of villas and elegantly designed rooms, along with the award-winning Talise Spa, offers a sanctuary for travelers looking to recharge and embark on a journey for wellbeing. Bahrain presents itself as a destination for the ultimate Middle Eastern experience, with its rich heritage of beautiful forts and charming bazaars blending perfectly with an inspirational vision for the future. The resort harmonises Jumeirah’s promise of unparalleled hospitality with the wonder of the destination, providing a true beachside escape in the heart of culture. Set to exceed all guest expectations, the resort and spa is an oasis for nature-loving friends, families and couples hoping to disconnect from the chaos of everyday life.

The Main Duties And Responsibilities Of This Role
Pick up the daily menus and insert them properly in their covers.

To seat reservations promptly at a table pre-set for the number in the party.
